limitations: Surface air temperature is dry-adiabatically extrapolated, not a Monin–Obukhov 2-m diagnostic
Ocean skin temperature is prescribed; it is not an independent SST prediction
Different climatology periods for SST boundary and POWER 2001–2020 observations
Two years of averaging and 24 reference points do not establish a globally validated climate model
Nearest coarse grid centers; distance and land fraction reported
24 points and two forecast years versus 2001–2020 MERRA-2/CERES climatology; no claim of a validated global mean
Skin temperature compared with TS, not an extrapolated surface-air diagnostic with T2M

reasons: Only one transient day, initialized with reference means; no spin-up or climatological averaging
Independent wet columns omit horizontal dynamics and real land/ocean boundary conditions
Statistical subgrid cloud area now matches the comparison variable, but cloud closure is not independently validated
The browser core has not undergone Held–Suarez; benchmarks of a separate Julia reference solver do not validate this core

targets.description: Provisional project targets, not published benchmark tolerances

assumptions: surface balance uses observed solar irradiance and albedo 0.15
no sensible/latent/ocean flux in conditional temperature
24 sampled points do not form a global map

limitations: Earth before/after uses the same grid, forcing and seed, but changes two physics defects jointly; it does not isolate each effect.
NASA POWER comparisons cover 24 points/288 monthly values, not a validated global-area climate map.
Actual Chromium production-core RCE is separate from SpeedyWeather Earth and Held-Suarez validation.
Browser one-day observation comparison has no climate spin-up; observed initialization is not predictive skill.
Native condensate optics are precipitation-derived; browser has no prognostic rain/snow distribution or snow aggregation.

browserControlledGeography.meaning: Controlled wet initial state; geography masks/conservation regression, not observed climate

browser300EnsembleContextLimitations: Table combines different model types, resolutions and sensitivity experiments
Published means discard the first 75 days; this experiment averages its final 200 days after at least 1,000 days
Inter-model spread is not an observational uncertainty or a certification tolerance
Table A1 contains no total cloud fraction reference
